opening.argument: The video does create an action pathway beyond the lecture itself: viewers are directed to download an app through an external Google Play link, while the presentation also repeatedly asks viewers to subscribe. That combination gives the content a promotional participation layer, even though the material does not clearly state a cash return. The relevant concern is that a low-effort viewer action is paired with an external destination and presented alongside health-related claims that may make the audience more receptive. The available evidence does not establish a reward, but it also does not remove the possibility that the app and engagement prompts are the practical objective.
